t: This is West House in Kensington, a home designed by Richard Norman Shaw, who is considered one of the greatest British architects, best known for his country houses and commercial buildings. His influence was strongest in the 1880s and 1890s. The house was commissioned by the painter George Henry Boughton, an Anglo-American landscape and genre artist, illustrator and writer. Boughton also died here, so this was both his commission and his home to the end of his life.
